verdict.rationale: Docs show async job submission and polling (create_task, run_tasks_until_done, submitting many jobs and querying results later) plus persistent chat sessions and checking artifacts once a task completes, supporting unattended long-running research jobs. However, there is no explicit evidence of a notification/webhook/email mechanism alerting the analyst when a job finishes — the workflow appears to require the client to poll or check back. Missing for 10: explicit push notification/webhook/email-on-completion feature, independent confirmation of long-running job reliability.
